an6.23:1.2: dukkhan ti bhikkhave kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ,
an6.23:1.3: rogo ti bhikkhave kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ,
an6.23:1.4: gaṇḍo ti bhikkhave kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ,
an6.23:1.5: saṅgo ti bhikkhave kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ,
an6.23:1.6: paṅko ti bhikkhave kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. 2.
an6.23:2.1: Kasmā ca bhikkhave bhayan ti kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ?
an6.23:2.2: Kāmarāgarattāyaṃ bhikkhave chandarāgavinibbaddho diṭṭhadhammikā pi bhayā na parimuccati, samparāyikā pi bhayā na parimuccati. Tasmā bhayan ti kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. 3.
an6.23:2.8: Kāmarāgarattāyaṃ bhikkhave chandarāgavinibaddho diṭṭhadhammikā pi paṅkā na parimuccati, samparāyikā pi paṅkā na parimuccati. Tasmā paṅko ti kāmānam etaṃ adhivacanan ti.
